Quick triage update (internal notes visible to Lumos with this thread):
- Observed elevated 5xx and KV cache eviction frequency on hyperspace5b starting at 08:47 PT. Error signature aligns with out-of-order KV pointers after a kernel scheduling change we rolled for a small subset of traffic at 08:30 PT.
- Telemetry snapshot attached: telemetry_snapshot_20261020.png
- Initial mitigation options (recommended order):
  1) Route Lumos traffic to hyperspace5b-v2-quant (compatibility preserved, narrower perf envelope)
  2) If quick route not acceptable, switch to hyperspace-lite in us-east-1 for the next 4 hours while we roll back the kernel scheduling change cluster-wide.
  3) Apply a patch to the runtime to guard KV pointer updates (ETA: ~3–5 hours, testing in staging now).

I'm pushing a hotfix branch and will validate on the canary fleet before wider rollout. If Lumos wants us to flip routing, we need an explicit OK to change the model target for their production traffic.

— Rafael
